use std::process::Command;

fn run_python_tests() -> Result<(), String> {
    // Test _unot function
    let output = Command::new("python3")
        .args(&["-c", "from idna import _unot; print(_unot(65)); print(_unot(4096)); print(_unot(65535))"])
        .output()
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    
    let result = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout);
    let lines: Vec<&str> = result.trim().lines().collect();
    
    assert_eq!(lines.len(), 3);
    assert_eq!(lines[0], "U+0041"); // 'A'
    assert_eq!(lines[1], "U+1000"); // 4096
    assert_eq!(lines[2], "U+FFFF"); // 65535
    
    Ok(())
}

#[test]
fn test_unot_format() {
    run_python_tests().unwrap();
}

use std::process::Command;

#[test]
fn test_valid_label_length_normal() {
    let output = Command::new("python3")
        .args(&["-c", "from idna import valid_label_length; print(valid_label_length('example')); print(valid_label_length('a'))"])
        .output()
        .expect("Failed to execute Python");
    
    let result = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout);
    assert!(result.contains("True"));
}

#[test]
fn test_valid_label_length_boundary() {
    let output = Command::new("python3")
        .args(&["-c", "from idna import valid_label_length; print(valid_label_length('a' * 63)); print(valid_label_length('a' * 64))"])
        .output()
        .expect("Failed to execute Python");
    
    let result = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout);
    let lines: Vec<&str> = result.trim().lines().collect();
    assert_eq!(lines[0], "True");  // 63 chars is valid
    assert_eq!(lines[1], "False"); // 64 chars is invalid
}

#[test]
fn test_valid_label_length_empty() {
    let output = Command::new("python3")
        .args(&["-c", "from idna import valid_label_length; print(valid_label_length(''))"])
        .output()
        .expect("Failed to execute Python");
    
    let result = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout);
    assert!(result.trim().contains("True"));
}

#[test]
fn test_valid_string_length() {
    let output = Command::new("python3")
        .args(&["-c", "from idna import valid_string_length; print(valid_string_length('a' * 253, False)); print(valid_string_length('a' * 254, False)); print(valid_string_length('a' * 254, True))"])
        .output()
        .expect("Failed to execute Python");
    
    let result = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout);
    let lines: Vec<&str> = result.trim().lines().collect();
    assert_eq!(lines[0], "True");   // 253 without trailing dot is valid
    assert_eq!(lines[1], "False");  // 254 without trailing dot is invalid
    assert_eq!(lines[2], "True");   // 254 with trailing dot is valid
}
